short_description: Sentinel — a federal Benefits Agency's improper-payment PREVENTION system. Improper payments run ~6% of ~$60B outlays (~$3.6B/yr), caught today after disbursement via slow 'pay-and-chase' recovery. Sentinel gives program-integrity examiners a governed pre-disbursement view that flags a risky payment AND prescribes the disposition — release, hold for verification, or refer to investigation — for the examiner to approve before funds move. A spike of high-risk pre-disbursement payments (cross-agency fraud-match feed + eligibility refresh ~3 weeks ago) surfaced duplicate identities, deceased payees, income mismatches, and cross-agency fraud flags. Every point of improper rate prevented pre-disbursement is ~$600M/yr; the assistant's AI spend is bounded (~$500K/yr, per-program-attributable) and every recommendation is audit-ready for the IG and GAO.
